minutes.text:
1 
 
RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
January 13, 2025  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins , COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle  Aldrich, Dr. Kathy Emmons , Ken 
Esquibel, Pete Laybourn (via Zoom), Mark Moody, Dr. Mark Rinne  (via Zoom), Scott Roybal, 
Tom Segrave and Jeff White. Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk. The pledge of allegiance was 
recited. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda. Upon request by Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by 
Mr. Roybal and Mr. White, item #16(b) was removed from the Consent Agenda. Upon request by 
Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by Mr. Esquibel and Mr. White, item #18(a) was 
removed from the Consent Agenda. Dr. Aldrich moved to approve remaining items, seconded by 
Mr. White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on December 23, 2024. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Sine Die Session of the Governing Body on January 6, 2025. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
[CA] Minutes from First Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on January 6, 2025. Motion 
(per Consent Agenda) carried.   
  
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land 
located north of Cheyenne Street and west of and adjacent to Ridge Road. Reporting for Public 
Services Committee, Mr. Segrave moved to approve on third and final  reading, seconded by Dr. 
Aldrich. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. (#4607) 
  
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of MR Medium -Density Residential for land 
annexed to the City of Cheyenne located north of Cheyenne Street and west of and adjacent to 
Ridge Road. Mr. Segrave moved to approve on third and final  reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich.  
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. (#4608) 
  
 
  2 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of AG Agricultural for land being annexed to the 
City at Lot 1, Block 1, North Range Substation, Laramie County, Wyoming (located south of 
Happy Jack Road, west of Bruns Way). Mr. Segrave moved to approve on third and final reading, 
seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. 
(#4609) 
  
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of AG Agricultural for land located northeast of 
the intersection of West Allison Road and Walterscheid Boulevard. Mr. Segrave moved to approve 
on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of 
the governing body with the exception of Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Moody voting “no”.  Public 
comment was made by: Kathy Deister and Randy Bonic. Comments were made by the following 
members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Moody and Dr. Rinne. (#4610)    
  
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from Planned Unit Development (PUD) (Ordinance 
#4274) to NR-3 Neighborhood Residential – High Density for land located north of West College 
Drive, south of West Allison Road, and west of Walterscheid Boulevard . Mr. Segrave moved to 
approve on third and final  reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all 
members of the governing body. (#4611)  
  
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending Section 10.12.020 of the Municipal Code of 
the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, clarifying that failure to maintain liability coverage is a jailable 
offense. Mr. Segrave moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion 
carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. (#4612)    
   
[CA] RESOLUTION –Reappropriating the Fiscal Year 2025 Budget of the City of Cheyenne 
according to the provisions of W.S. §§ 16- 4-112 & 16- 4-113 – referred to Finance Committee.  
(Sponsor – Mr. Laybourn) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for 
Holliday Park, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located northeast of the intersection 
of East Lincolnway and Morrie Avenue) – referred to Public Services Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. 
Segrave) 
 
[CA]  Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and WYDOT for a Wyoming Rural Public 
Transportation grant to assist in providing local match for operating funds for the Transit Program 
or Fiscal Year 2025 (Revenue to the City) . Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount 
not to exceed $300,000.00). (#8115)  
 
  Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Wyoming Cattle Company for the Belvoir 
Ranch Grazing Lease. (Revenue to the City) . Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. Roybal 
moved to approve in an amount of $210,000.00 annually for three years, seconded by Mr. White. 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. Comments were made by the 
following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Laybourn and Mr. 
Segrave. (#8116)  3 
 
[CA] Human Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and United Way of Laramie 
County to provide funding to community agencies and monitor performance of community 
programs (2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee.  
 
[CA]  Consideration to purchase between the City of Cheyenne and Zivaro for Quest Netvault  
Software for the City of Cheyenne IT Department (General Fund).  Motion (per Consent Agenda) 
carried (in an amount not to exceed $125,000.00). (#8117) 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E-7-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Alco 
Fence Co. Inc. for the Happy Jack Landfill Litter Fence Maintenance and Repair Services Project 
(Solid Waste Fund). Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed 
$381,800.00). (#8118) 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S -10-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Cheyenne Tile and Stone for the Kiwanis Community House – Hardwood Floor Replacement 
project (One Time State Distribution Funds) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #E -8-25 for a 15,000 GVWR, Gasoline Powered, 4- Wheel Drive 
Regular Cab and Chassis Truck With A 14- Foot Stake Bed for the Sanitation Division (Solid 
Waste Fund / Equipment) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #E-10-25 for One (1) Front Load Refuse Truck, and Three (3) Dual 
Arm Refuse Trucks for the Sanitation Division (Solid Waste Fund / Equipment)  – referred to 
Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #E-11-25 for Two (2) Solid Waste Transfer Trailers (Walking Floor) 
for the Sanitation Division (Solid Waste Fund / Equipment) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
  Request to extend the time period in which Scooters Scoreboard, LLC d/b/a Scooters 
Scoreboard Bar has to become operational for an additional year for their retail liquor license, 
located at 619 East Lincolnway, Cheyenne, Wyoming. Mr. Roybal moved to approve, seconded 
by Mr. Moody. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. Comments 
were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Dr. Rinne. 
 
 Governing body comment s were made by Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Moody on the Voucher 
Report as presented. 
 
 Announcement was made that due to the Martin Luther King Jr. Holiday on Monday, 
January 20, 2025, the regularly scheduled City Council Committee meetings will instead be held 
in the Municipal Building, Room 104, 2101 O’Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, WY, and via electronic 
conference meeting as follows: Public Services Committee will meet Tuesday, January 21, 2025 
at Noon and Finance Committee will meet Wednesday, January 22, 2025 at Noon. 
 
 Public comments were made by the following under Other Business: Corey Lynn Loghry, 
Sam Galeotos, Bryan Grzegorczyk, Glenn Garrett, Steve Borin, Astrid, Susan Allen, Sandy Inniss 
and Virginia Dandy Brinkerhoff.  
   4 
 
 Comments were made by the following members of the governing body under other 
business: Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Moody and Mr. Segrave.   
 
 There being no further business to come before the  governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 6:59 p.m. 
 
        Submitted by, 
 
              
        Kylie Soden, 
        City Clerk 
 
This notice is available in alternative, accessible formats upon request. 
 
Published: Wyoming Tribune-Eagle 
  January 18, 2025

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
February 24, 2025 
 
 The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in special session on this date beginning 
at 7:35 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting, for the purpose of 
collective labor bargaining with the Cheyenne Professional Firefighters, International Association 
of Firefighters, Local No. 279.  Present were: MAYOR – Patrick Collins, COUNCIL MEMBERS 
– Dr. Michelle Aldrich,  Dr. Kathy Emmons, Ken Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, Mark Moody, Scott 
Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff White.  Absent: Dr. Mark Rinne.  Also present: Kylie Soden, City 
Clerk, Amber Ash, Chief of Staff, John Brodie, City Attorney, Robin Lockman, City Treasurer  
and Chief John Kopper and Deputy Chief Andrew Dykshorn, Cheyenne Fire Rescue. The pledge 
of allegiance was recited. 
 
Mayor Collins provided opening comments  and noted the importance of the labor 
management discussions that occur leading up to negotiations. He provided meeting room location 
information that would be used for the purpose of caucusing if needed. The proposed Ground Rules 
were agreed upon and signed by the City and Union. [Clerk’s note: City’s Spokespersons we re 
Mayor Patrick Collins, City Attorney John Brodie and City Council Vice President Scott Roybal.  
The Union’s Spokespersons were Neil Durante, Vincent McQueeney and Chris Thoms .]  Mayor 
Collins and Vincent McQueeney, Spokesperson for the Cheyenne Professional Firefighters, 
International Association of Firefighters, Local No. 279, expressed mutual appreciation for their 
continued collaboration in working together on the Collective Labor Agreement. 
   
Mayor Collins and Union Spokesperson McQueeney reviewed the proposed agreement 
which included changes to the following: Section 2 – Definitions; Section 4 – Term of Agreement; 
Section 13 – Management Rights; Section 15 – Department Staffing; Section 21 – Classification 
of Employment and Basic Wages; Section 22 – Overtime;  Section 23 – Working in a Highter Job 
Rank; Section 24 – Conversion of Benefit Hours; Section 25 – Wellness/Fitness Program; Section 
27 – Sick Leave and Section 42 – Longevity Pay. Mayor Collins and Mr. McQueeney announced 
acceptance of the proposed agreement as written.   
 
  There bein g no fur ther business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 8:04 p.m.  
 
       Submitted by, 
        
        
       Kylie Soden, Deputy City Clerk

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
April 14, 2025  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins, COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Ken Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, 
Mark Moody, Dr. Mark Rinne , Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff White. Absent: Dr. Kathy 
Emmons. Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk. The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda. Upon request by Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by 
Mr. Moody and Mr. White, item #17(a) was removed from the Consent Agenda. Upon request by 
Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Moody, item #19(c) was 
removed from the Consent Agenda. Dr. Aldrich moved to approve the remaining items, seconded 
by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on March 24, 2025. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing for a bar & grill liquor license application filed with 
the City Clerk’s Office for Frontier Daze, LLC d/b/a Cheba Hut, 3838 Atkin St., Cheyenne, WY. 
Public comment was made by: Seth Lars en, Cheba Hut. Comments were made by the following 
members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Esquibel. There being no further comments 
or input and the purpose of the hearing having been met, Mayor Collins closed the public hearing 
and referred the application to Finance Committee. 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne, changing the zoning classification for land located southwest of the intersection of Wild 
Bluff and Ogden Road from MR Medium-Density Residential to NR-2 Neighborhood Residential 
- Medium Density. Reporting for Public Services Committee, Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 
third and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present. (#4618) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending Section 10.24.190, Critical Traffic Control 
Areas; Creation and Administration; Enhanced Penalties, of the Municipal Code of the City of 
Cheyenne, Wyoming, Modifying the provisions governing the creation and enforcement of such 
areas. Mr. Segrave moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried. 
Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
  2 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending Chapter 10.82, Motor -assisted Scooters, 
Electric Bicycles, and Bicycles Equipped with GPS of Title 10, Vehicles and Traffic, of the 
Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, authorizing dockless vehicle companies to 
conduct business in the city using the city's formal procurement process, making a conforming 
amendment and repealing obsolete provisions . Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. Laybourn 
moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. White. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend Section 
10.82.110 (A)(2) to add “in a timely manner,” seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion to amend carried. 
Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present with the exception of Dr. Rinne and 
Mr. Roybal voting “no.” Dr. Aldrich moved to amend Section 10.82.110 to remove items (A)(8) 
and (B)(9), seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion to amend failed. Voting “no” – all members of the 
governing body present with the exception of  Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Moody voting 
“yes.” Mr. Moody moved to amend Section 10.82.110 to remove  items (A)(3), (A)(4), (A)(5 ), 
(A)(7), (B)(6) and (B)(7), seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion to amend failed. Voting “no” – all 
members of the governing body present with the exception of Mr. Moody voting “yes.” Mr. Moody 
moved to amend Section 10.82.110 (C) to replace “may select one or more” with “may select any 
operator,” seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion to amend failed. Voting “no” – all members of the 
governing body present with the exception of Mr. Moody voting “yes.” Main motion as amended 
carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present with the exception o f Mr. 
Laybourn and Mr. Moody voting “no.” Comments were made by the following members of the 
governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Moody, Dr. Rinne and Mr. Roybal. 
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending and updating the Solid Waste Fee Schedule in 
accordance with Section 8.44.010 of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming and 
repealing Ordinance No. 4571 – referred to Finance Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Laybourn) 
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Repealing Chapter 12.28, Downtown Graffiti Abatement 
Pilot Program of Title 12, Streets, Sidewalks and Public Places, of the Municipal Code of the City 
of Cheyenne, Wyoming – referred to Public Services Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
 RESOLUTION – Granting an exception to the '201 Agreement' for the owner of the 
property located south of High Plains Road and west of South Greeley Highway, between Robert 
Avenue and Dayshia Lane . Mr. Segrave advised there was no recommendation from Public 
Services Committee. Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Roybal . Dr. Rinne moved to 
postpone to April 28, 2025, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion to postpone carried. Voting “yes” 
– all members of the governing body present. Public comment was made by: Tanya Keller. 
Comment was made by the following member of the governing body: Mayor Collins. 
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Re-appropriating the Fiscal Year 2025 Budget of the City of Cheyenne 
according to the provisions of W.S. §§ 16- 4-112 and 16-4-113 – referred to Finance Committee. 
(Sponsor – Mr. Laybourn) 
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for 
Trailhead Estates, 1st Filing, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located northeast of 
the intersection of Ogden Road and Crane Bluff Road)  – referred to Public Services Committee. 
(Sponsor – Mr. Segrave)  3 
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for 
Trailhead Estates, 2nd Filing, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located northwest of 
the intersection of Ogden Road and Crane Bluff Road)  – referred to Public Services Committee. 
(Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Jolly 
Rogers, 3rd Filing, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located Northwest of U.S. 30 
and Whitney Road) – referred to Public Services Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
  Cooperative Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Wyoming Department of  
Transportation for 2025 Thermoplastic Pavement Markings (2023 -2026 Optional 1% Sales Tax 
Fund).  Mr. Laybourn moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $234,845.00, seconded by 
Mr. Moody. Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, 
Mr. Laybourn, Mr. Moody and Mr. Segrave. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present. (#8160) 
 
[CA]  Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7633 between the City of Cheyenne and Laramie 
County Community College for the CDL “Your Truck” Training Program (Various City Funds )  
– referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7955 between the City of Cheyenne and Trihydro 
Corporation for Landfill Mapping and Survey Services (Solid Waste Fund)  – referred to Finance 
Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S-12-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and BCM, 
Inc, d/b/a Mortensen Electric, for the Dutcher Fields Lighting Installation project  (One Time 
Distribution Funds & Community Facility Fees ). Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (in an 
amount not to exceed $729,000.00). (#8161) 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -13-25 for one (1) Rough Mower for the City of Cheyenne Golf 
Division. (Golf Fund) Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (accepted the bid from LL Johnson 
Distributing Company in an amount not to exceed $79,310.11). 
 
  Consideration of Bid #E-14-25 for furnishing Bituminous Asphalt Hot Mix, Tack Oil, and 
Cold Mix on an annual basis, for the City of Cheyenne, Street & Alley Division (2019- 2022 
Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund). Mr. Laybourn moved to accept the bid from JTL Group Inc. d/b/a 
Knife River for hot mix and cold mix in an amount not to exceed $442,625.00 and to accept the 
bid from Simon Contractors for tack oil in an amount not to exceed $19,200.00 for a total amount 
not to exceed $461,825.00, seconded by Mr. Moody. Comment w as made by the following 
member of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -16-25 for furnishing a 2000 Gallon Single Axle Oil Distributor 
Truck for the City of Cheyenne, Street & Alley Division (2023- 2026 Optional 1% Sales Tax)  – 
referred to Finance Committee. 
  4 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -17-25 for furnishing a 2000 Gallon Water Truck for the City of 
Cheyenne, Street & Alley Division (2019- 2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax)  – referred to  Finance 
Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -18-25 for furnishing a 30 Yard Rolloff Truck for the City of 
Cheyenne, Sanitation Division (Solid Waste Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Designation of Official Voting Delegate and Alternate Delegate for the City of Cheyenne 
at the June 12, 2025 Wyoming Association of Municipalities Summer Convention Business 
Meeting to be held in Cheyenne, Wyoming. Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried ( designated 
President Rinne as the Official Voting Delegate and Mayor Collins as the Alternate).  
 
 No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
 Announcement was made of a Public Hearing  to be held April 28, 2025 at 6:00 p.m. in 
City Council Chambers, 2101 O’Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, WY, and via electronic conference 
meeting, for a winery liquor license application filed with the City Clerk’s Office for Wagonhound 
Wine LLC d/b/a Wagonhound Wine Company, 1610 Capitol Ave., Cheyenne, WY. 
 
Announcement was made that effective the week of April 21, 2025, Finance and Public 
Services Committee meetings will be held in City Council Chambers, 2101 O’Neil Avenue. 
 
 The following members of the governing body made comments under Other Business: Dr. 
Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, Mr. Moody and Mr. White. 
  
 There being no further business to come before the  governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 6:47 pm. 
 
        Submitted by, 
 
              
        Kylie Soden, 
        City Clerk

Office of City Clerk 
 
April 28, 2025  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins , COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle  Aldrich, Dr. Kathy Emmons, Ken 
Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, Mark Moody, Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff White (via Zoom). 
Absent: Dr. Mark Rinne . Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk. The pledge of allegiance was 
recited. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda. Upon request by Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by 
Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Moody, item #13 was removed from the Consent Agenda. Upon request by 
Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Moody, item #21(a) was 
removed from the Consent Agenda. Mr. Roybal moved to approve remaining items, seconded by 
Mr. Segrave. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on April 14,  2025. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing for a winery liquor license application filed with 
the City Clerk’s Office for Wagonhound Wine LLC d/b/a Wagonhound Wine Company, 1610 
Capitol Ave., Cheyenne, WY. Public comment was made by: Jackson Laybourn. Comments were 
made by the following members of the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich and Mayor Collins. There 
being no further comments or input and the purpose of the hearing having been met, Mayor Collins 
closed the public hearing and referred the application to Finance Committee. 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending Section 10.24.190, Critical Traffic Control 
Areas; Creation and Administration; Enhanced Penalties, of the Municipal Code of the City of 
Cheyenne, Wyoming, modifying the provisions governing the creation and enforcement of such 
areas. Reporting for Public Services Committee, Mr. Segrave moved to approve on third and final 
reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body present with the exception of Mr. Laybourn voting “no”. (#4619) 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending Chapter 10.82, Motor -assisted Scooters, 
Electric Bicycles, and Bicycles Equipped with GPS of Title 10, Vehicles and Traffic, of the 
Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, authorizing dockless vehicle companies to 
conduct business in the city using the city's formal procurement process, making a conforming 
amendment and repealing obsolete provisions . Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. Laybourn 
moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Mr. Moody moved to amend  2 
 
by removing Section 10.82.110(A) numbers 7 and 8 a nd Section 10.82.110(B) numbers 7 and 9, 
seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend the amendment by adding back in Section 
10.82.110(A) number 7 and Section 10.82.110(B) number 7, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion to 
amend the amendment carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present with the 
exception of Mr. Roybal voting “no”. Motion to amend failed. Voting “no” – all members of the 
governing body present with the exception of Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Moody voting 
“yes”. Dr. Aldrich moved to amend S ection 4 by changing 40 days to 14 days, seconded by Mr. 
Esquibel. Motion to amend carried. Voting “yes” all members of the governing body present. Mr. 
Segrave moved to amend to replace Section 4 language with the following: “Upon the effective 
date of this ordinance as specified by Section 6, the city clerk shall not renew any dockless vehicle 
license issued pursuant to former Section 10.82.030, as repealed herein. Upon the City’s issuance 
of the first operating agreement in accordance with Section 1 of this ordinance, the city clerk shall 
provide written notice to each person holding a dockless vehicle license issued under the repealed 
Section 10.82.030. The notice shall state that the licensee shall have no more than forty (40) days 
from the expiration date of the licensee’s dockless vehicle license to remove any and all property 
associated with the licensee's dockless  vehicle operations from the public right -of-way. The 
required notice shall be sent to the licensee’s address of record and, if available, to the licensee’s 
email address on file with the city clerk. Any property remaining in the public right -of-way after 
the expiration of the forty (40) day period shall be deemed abandoned and may be removed and 
disposed of by the City in accordance with applicable state and local laws”,  seconded by Mr. 
Roybal. Motion to amend carried. Voting “yes” all members of the governing body present with 
the exception of Mr. Laybourn voting “no”. Main motion, as amended, carried. Voting “yes” – all 
members of the governing body present with the exception of Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Moody voting 
“no”. Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor 
Collins, Dr. Emmons, Mr. Moody and Mr. Roybal. (#4620) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending and updating the Solid Waste Fee Schedule 
in accordance with Section 8.44.010 of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming 
and repealing Ordinance No. 4571. Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on second reading, seconded 
by Mr. Roybal. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present with 
the exception of Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Moody voting “no”. 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Repealing Chapter 12.28, Downtown Graffiti Abatement 
Pilot Program of Title 12, Streets, Sidewalks and Public Places, of the Municipal Code of the City 
of Cheyenne, Wyoming. Mr. Segrave moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Dr. 
Emmons. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present.

definitions – referred to Public Services Committee. (Sponsors – Mr. Moody and Mr. Segrave)

moved to postpone to May 12, 2025, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion to postpone carried. Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body present.   3

according to the provisions of W.S. §§ 16- 4-112 and 16- 4-113. Mr. Laybourn moved to a dopt, 
seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body  
present. Comment was made by the following member of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich. (#6458)

recording of the plat, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present. Public comment was made by: John Edwards, Edwards Development and

and south of Storey Boulevard – referred to Public Services Committee (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
[CA]  RESOLUTION – Certifying and adopting the Belvoir Ranch Master Plan – referred to 
Public Services Committee (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
  Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7633 between the City of Cheyenne and Laramie 
County Community College for the CDL “Your Truck” Training Program (Various City Funds ). 
Mr. Laybourn moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion carried. Voting “yes” all 
members of the governing body present. Comment w as made by the following member of the 
governing body: Dr. Aldrich. (#7633)  4 
 
[CA]  Contract Modification #1 to Contract #7955 between the City of Cheyenne and Trihydro 
Corporation for Landfill Mapping and Survey Services (Solid Waste Fund). Motion (per Consent 
Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed $49,008.00). (#7955) 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -16-25 for furnishing a 2000 Gallon Single Axle Oil Distributor

Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (accepted the bid from Floyd’s Truck Center Inc., Cheyenne, 
in an amount not to exceed $307,361.75). 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -17-25 for furnishing a 2000 Gallon Water Truck for the City of

Agenda) carried (accepted the bid from Floyd’s Truck Center Inc., Cheyenne, in an amount not to 
exceed $416,227.70). 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #E -18-25 for furnishing a 30 Yard Rolloff Truck for the City of

(accepted the bid from Floyd’s Truck Center Inc., Cheyenne, in an amount not to exceed 
$232,698.85). 
 
[CA]  Consideration to purchase between the City of Cheyenne and Advanced Security 
Technologies LLC, for the purchase of nine (9) Modular Vehicle Barrier Systems and Trailer

[CA]  Consideration to purchase between the City of Cheyenne and Ace Equipment & Supply 
Company, for the purchase of two (2) sets of Rotary Mobile -Column Lifting Systems (Fleet 
Maintenance Fund & Solid Waste Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S -17-25 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and JTL

[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S-18-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Miller 
& Sons Construction Inc. for the 2025 Miscellaneous Concrete Project (2023- 2026 Optional 1% 
Sales Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S-21-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and T C

(2017 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Bar & grill liquor license application filed with the City Clerk’s Office for Frontier Daze, 
LLC d/b/a Cheba Hut, 3838 Atkin St., Cheyenne, WY. Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Appointment of Jennifer Jo Barley-Dunning to the Housing and Community Development 
Advisory Council. Mr. Roybal moved to approve, seconded by Dr. Emmons. Motion carried. 
Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body with the exception of  Mayor Collins who did 
not vote (mayoral appointment).  
  5 
 
 Governing body comment was made by Mr. Moody on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
 No comments were made on the Revenue Report as presented.

The following members of the governing body made comments under Other Business: Dr.

 There being no further business to come before the  governing body, the meeting was

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
May 27, 2025  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins , COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle  Aldrich, Dr. Kathy Emmons, Ken 
Esquibel, Pete Laybourn (via Zoom), Mark Moody, Dr. Mark Rinne, Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave 
and Jeff White. Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk. The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
 Expression of Appreciation of the 2024- 2025 Youth Council and State of the Youth 
Address was made. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda. Upon request by Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by 
Mr. Moody and Mr. White, items #17, #19, #21 and #28(a)  were removed from the Consent 
Agenda. Upon request by Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by Mr. Moody and Mr. 
Segrave, item #22 was removed from the Consent Agenda.  Upon request by Mr. Moody, and 
pursuant to support received by Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Laybourn, item #28(c) was removed from the 
Consent Agenda.  Mr. White moved to approve remaining items, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion 
carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on May 12,  2025. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing to determine whether compliance of annexation 
conditions required by Wyoming Statute §15- 1-402 exist for the City- initiated annexation of 95 
parcels of land totaling roughly 44.56 acres comprised of various tracts of land and rights-of-way 
situate in northeast Cheyenne generally located north of Dell Range Boulevard, east and west of 
Ridge Road, and south of Storey Boulevard. Public comments were made by: Daniel Singh, Mary 
Simons, Kevin Tanner, Jared Hasenauer and Exie Brown. Comments were made by the following 
members of the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Moody and Mr. White . There 
being no further comments or input and the purpose of the public hearing having been met, Mayor 
Collins closed the public hearing. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing for a restaurant liquor license application filed with 
the City Clerk's Office for Cheyenne Hokkaido LLC d/b/a Cheyenne Hokkaido Ramen, 1720 
Capitol Ave., Cheyenne, WY. There being no comments or input and the purpose of the public 
hearing having been met, Mayor Collins closed the public hearing and referred the application to 
Finance Committee.  
  2 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending Sections 1.4.3, 1.4.4, and 5.7.2 of the Unified 
Development Code to amend specific uses allowed as Home Occupations and add clarifying 
definitions. Reporting for Public Services Committee, Mr. Segrave moved to approve on third and 
final reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich . Mr. Segrave moved to amend by substitute dated May 9, 
2025, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion to amend by substitute carried. Voting “yes” – all members 
of the governing body. Mr. Segrave moved to amend section 5.7.2 (j)(5) to add after “employing” 
to include “or apprenticing”, seconded by Dr. Aldrich . Motion to amend carried. Voting “yes” – 
all members of the governing body. Main motion as amended by substitute, as amended, carried. 
Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body with the exception of Mr. Laybourn and Dr. 
Rinne voting “no”. Comments were made by the following members of the governing body:  Dr. 
Aldrich, Mayor Collins and Mr. Moody. (#4623) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Appropriating moneys for the City of Cheyenne, 
Wyoming, for the various purposes in conducting the municipal government of said City and fixing 
the amount of general and special taxes as part of the revenue required to meet the said 
appropriation, all for the Fiscal Year beginning July 1, 2025, and ending June 30, 2026. Reporting 
for the Committee of the Whole, Dr. Rinne moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. 
White. Dr. Rinne moved to amend by substitute dated May 22, 2025, seconded by Mr. Segrave. 
Motion to amend by substitute carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. Dr. 
Aldrich moved to amend to increase the City Council’s Regular Employee line item by $6,346.00 
and applicable benefit line items by $1,548.00 and decrease the Miscellaneous Insurance line item 
by $7,894.00, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion to amend carried. Voting “yes” – all members of 
the governing body. Mr. Moody moved to amend to decrease the City Council Professional 
Development line item by $1.000.00 and to increase the Miscellaneous Fund by $1,000.00. Motion 
to amend died due to lack of second. Mr. Esquibel moved to amend to increase the Community 
Recreation and Events  Clean and Safe Program,  Maintenance and Supplies line item  by 
$10,000.00 and decrease the City Reserves fund by the same amount, seconded by Dr. Emmons. 
Motion to amend failed. Voting “no” – all members of the governing body with the exception of  
Dr. Emmons, Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Roybal voting “yes”.  Main motion, as amended by substitute, 
as amended, carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body.  Public comment was 
made by: Lisa Rattery  and Josie Forin. Comments were made by the following members of the 
governing body:  Dr. Aldrich , Mayor Collins, Dr. Emmons  and Dr. Rinne . The following is a 
summary of the proposed budget including aforementioned amendments:  General Fund , 
$74,517,876; Weed and Pest, $ 801,700; Youth Alternatives Grants, $ 919,234; Recreation 
Programs, $2,656,270, Community Development Block Grant , $660,183; Law Enforcement 
Grants, $267,441; Miscellaneous Federal Grants, $1,125,070; Transportation Planning, 
$1,805,225; Transit, $6,023,629; Juvenile Justice, $280,726; Youth Alternatives Mentoring,  
$73,794; Development Impact Fees, $ 1,531,100; One Percent Sales Tax, $13,878,876; Speci fic 
Purpose Option Tax, $595,554; Youth Activities, $19,195; Golf Facilities, $ 570,700; Fleet

to determine whether compliance of annexation conditions required by Wyoming Statute §15- 1-
402 exist for the City- initiated annexation of 38 parcels of land totaling roughly 49.86 acres 
comprised of various tracts of land and rights-of-way situate in eastern Cheyenne generally located 
south of Dell Range Boulevard, east of Dry Cree k, west of Whitney Road, and north of Charles 
Street.  
 
 Public commen t was made by the following under Other Business: John Brodie, City 
Attorney. 
 
The following members of the governing body made comments under Other Business: Dr. 
Aldrich, Mr. Moody and Mr. Segrave. 
 
Dr. Rinne  moved to meet in executive session Pursuant to Wyoming Statute §16- 4- 
405(a)(vii), seconded by Dr. Emmons . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body. Mayor Collins announced members would meet in executive session, not open to  7 
 
the public and stated there would be no action taken by the governing body as a result of the 
executive session, and that the regular City Council meeting would officially conclude at the close 
of the executive session. The following staff members were in attendance: Amber Ash, Mayor’s 
Chief of Staff; John Brodie, City Attorney; Brenda Moureaux, Deputy City Treasurer and Kylie 
Soden, City Clerk. 
  
 There being no further business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 8:53 p.m. 
 
        Submitted by, 
 
              
        Kylie Soden, 
        City Clerk

OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
July 14, 2025  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins , COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle  Aldrich, Dr. Kathy Emmons, Ken 
Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, Mark Moody, Dr. Mark Rinne , Scott Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff 
White. Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk. The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda . Dr. Aldrich moved to approve, seconded by Mr. White. Motion 
carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present.

Consent Agenda) carried.

west of Whitney Road, and north of Charles Street. Public comment was made by : Suzanne 
Slattery. Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and 
Mr. Moody. There being no further comments or input and the purpose of the public hearing having 
been met, Mayor Collins closed the public hearing.

by Mr. White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. (#4630)

Cheyenne, Wyoming, relating to the sale, transport, discharge, possession and regulation of 
firearms to better con form to state statute and avoid duplication with federal law. Mr. Segrave

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
July 28, 2025  
  
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins , COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle  Aldrich, Dr. Kathy Emmons, Ken 
Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, Mark Moody, Dr. Mark Rinne (arrived at 6:33 via Zoom), Scott Roybal 
and Tom Segrave. Absent:  Jeff White. Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk.  The pledge of 
allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda. Mr. Segrave moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion 
carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on Ju ly 14, 2025. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing for a transfer of ownership of restaurant liquor 
license application filed with the City Clerk's Office for Pothos Business LLC d/b/a Bella Fuoco, 
2115 Warren Ave., Cheyenne, WY (license currently held by Penstemon Business LLC d/b/a Bella 
Fuoco). Public comment was made by: Brenna Kosowicz. Comments were made by the following 
members of the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Roybal . There being no further comments 
or input and the purpose of the public hearing having been met, Mayor Collins closed the public 
hearing and referred the application to Finance Committee. 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending and repealing multiple Sections of Chapter 
9.24, Weapons, of Title 9, Public Peace and Welfare, of the Municipal Code of the City of 
Cheyenne, Wyoming, relating to the sale, transport, discharge, possession and regulation of 
firearms to better con form to state statute and avoid duplication with federal law. Reporting for 
Public Services Committee, Mr. Segrave moved to approve on third and final  reading, seconded 
by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. (#4634) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, various 
tracts of land completely surrounded by current City limits situate in eastern Cheyenne, generally 
located south of Dell Range Boulevard, east of Dry Creek, west of Whitney Road, and north of 
Charles Street . Mr. Segrave moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Dr. Emmons . 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present with the exception of 
Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Moody voting “no”. Public comments were made by: Trish Morris and Mark 
Morris. Comments were made by the following members of the governing body:  Dr. Aldrich, 
Mayor Collins and Mr. Moody.  2 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne, establishing the zoning classifications of: AR - Agricultural Residential; MR - Medium-
Density Residential; HR -  High-Density Residential; CB -  Community Business; and, MUR -  
Mixed-Use Residential, for land annexed to the City of Cheyenne generally located south of Dell 
Range Boulevard, east of Dry Creek, west of Whitney Road, and north of Charles Street . Mr. 
Segrave moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Dr. Emmons . Motion carried. Voting 
“yes” – all members of the governing body present. Comments were made by the following 
members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Moody. 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne, changing the zoning classification for land located south of Interstate 80 and west of 
Roundtop Road from LI – Light Industrial to BP - Business Park. Mr. Segrave moved to approve 
on second reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present. 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Defining the terms and conditions of employment for 
sworn officers of the Cheyenne Police Department for Fiscal Year 2025- 2026. Reporting for 
Finance Committee, Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. Moody. 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present.   
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – To amend the Official Zoning Map of the Cheyenne 
Unified Development Code, for property located east of South Greeley Highway and north of 
Chalk Bluff Road in Cheyenne, Wyoming, changing the zoning classification from HI (Heavy 
Industrial) and AG (Agricultural) to BP (Business Park). Mr. Segrave moved to approve on second 
reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body present. 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Certifying compliance with Wyoming Statute § 15 -1-402 for the City-
initiated annexation of various tracts of land completely surrounded  by current city limits situate 
in east Cheyenne generally located south Dell Range Boulevard, west of Dry Creek, east of North 
College Drive, and north of Cheyenne Street. Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6482) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Authorizing the City of Cheyenne to enter into a Memorandum of 
Understanding with Cheyenne LEADS to establish and administer a Large Projects Gap Finance 
Program, utilizing voter-approved 6th Penny Sales and Use Tax Funds for economic development 
– referred to Finance Committee. (Sponsors – Mr. Segrave and Mr. White) 
 
[CA] Memorandum of Understanding between City of Cheyenne, Cheyenne Police Department, 
and Laramie County School District Number One for the School Resource Officers Program 
(Revenue to the City).  Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#8226) 
 
[CA] Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and GLM Design Group, 
LLC, for the Clear Creek Inline Stormwater Detention Facility project (2023 -2026 Optional One 
Percent Sales Tax Fund and FEMA BRIC Grant) . Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (in an 
amount not to exceed $403,742.16). (#8227) 
  3 
 
[CA] Right-of-Way License Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and First National Bank 
of Omaha for existing onsite parking in the rights -of-way of E. Pershing Boulevard and E. 23rd 
Street and an existing pole sign located in the right -of-way of Pershing Boul evard. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. (#8228) 
 
[CA] Fence Installation and Access License Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Richard Menkin for fence installation on City- owned property described as Lot 6, Block 3, 
Campstool Addition, 3rd Filing, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming – referred to Public 
Services Committee.  
 
[CA] Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and TDSi - The Design 
Studio, inc., for the High Plains Arboretum: Greenhouse (State Parks and Cultural Resources 
Funds) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
 Contract Modification #1 to Contract #8098 between the City of Cheyenne and Fencetrack 
Inc. d/b/a Full Tilt Services for additional work associated with the Belvoir Ranch Trailhead and 
Access Roads project (Belvoir Ranch Recreation Fund) . Mr. Laybourn moved to approve in an 
amount not to exceed $ 120,556.50, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all 
members of the governing body present with the exception of Mr. Moody voting “no”. Comments 
were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins and Mr. 
Moody. (#8098) 
 
[CA] Consideration to Purchase between the City of Cheyenne, and Critical Facilities 
Technology / Schneider Electric, for the Cheyenne Public Safety Center, Modular Power 
Revitalization Service (2012 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund and One Time State Distribution 
Funds). Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed $92,526.00).  
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S -28-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Construction Specialists, Inc., for the Ice Slicer Building - Demolition and New Steel Structure 
(2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #E-3-25 for two (2) Mid- Size Trucks for the City of Cheyenne, 
Cheyenne Fire Rescue Department (Public Safety Infrastructure Fees)  – referred to Finance 
Committee. 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #E-19-25 for furnishing Mid-Size SUVs and a Full-Size SUV for the 
City of Cheyenne Compliance, Community Recreation and Events and Cheyenne Fire Rescue 
Departments (2023-2026 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund and One Time State Distribution Funds) – 
referred to Finance Committee. 
 
 Governing body comment was made by Dr. Aldrich on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
 No comments were made on the Revenue Report as presented. 
  
State of Wyoming Department of Audit Report and Results of the City credit card usage 
audit. Mr. Segrave moved to acknowledge receipt of the report, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion 
carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. Public comment was made by:  4 
 
Brian Wilson and Suzanne Moreno, State of Wyoming, Department of Audit. Comment s were 
made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Dr. Emmons. 
 
Announcement was made of a Public Hearing to be held August 11, 2025 at 6:00 p.m. in 
City Council Chambers, 2101 O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, WY, and via electronic conference 
meeting, to determine whether compliance of annexation conditions required by Wyoming Statute 
§15-1-402 exist for about 18.62 acres of land located northeast of the intersection of Frontier Mall 
Dr. and Rue Terre Avenue and west of Converse Avenue.  
 
The following members of the governing body made comments under Other Business: Dr. 
Aldrich, Dr. Emmons and Mr. Moody. 
  
 There being no further business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 6:45 p.m. 
 
        Submitted by, 
 
              
        Kylie Soden, 
        City Clerk

Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to revise and enhance provisions governing 
vehicle mufflers and noise, to establish a graduated penalty structure for recurring offenses, and to 
make conforming amendments as specified . Mr. Segrave moved to approve on second reading, 
seconded by Mr. White. Mr. Segrave moved to postpone t o September 8, 2025, seconded by Dr.

Construction Account Grant application to the State Loan and Investment Board on Behalf of the 
City of Cheyenne for the purchase of a Type 6 Wildland Brush Truck with equipment – referred 
to Finance Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Laybourn) 
 
[CA] Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne  and Laramie County to 
provide transit service to the Laramie County Community College and the area immediately 
adjacent to the City of Cheyenne (Revenue to the City) – referred to Finance Committee.

of Health, Aging Division to provide transportation support services to persons 60 years or older 
under the Title III -B Program Grant for FY 2026 (Revenue to the City) – referred to Finance 
Committee.

§15-1-402 exist for the City-initiated annexation of 35 parcels of land totaling roughly 20.19 acres

Up LLC d/b/a Wasabi Japanese Steakhouse, 4620 Grandview Ave. #205.

officially adjourned at 6:27 p.m.

        City Clerk

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
September 22, 2025  
 
 The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in Council Chambers and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: MAYOR 
– Patrick Collins , COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle  Aldrich, Dr. Kathy Emmons, Ken 
Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, Mark Moody, Dr. Mark Rinne , Scott Roybal , Tom Segrave and Jeff 
White. Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk. The pledge of allegiance was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda. Dr. Aldrich moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion 
carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on September 8, 2025. Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing for a transfer of ownership of retail liquor license 
application filed with the City Clerk's Office for Apple Colorado, LLC, d/b/a Applebee's 
Neighborhood Grill & Bar, 1401 Dell Range Blvd., Cheyenne, WY (license currently held by AB 
Cheyenne, WY, LLC d/b/a Applebee's Neighborhood Grill & Bar). Public comment was made by: 
Brain Call, A rea Director for Applebee’s and Brian Proffitt, representative for Apple Colorado 
LLC. Comments were made by the following member s of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and 
Mr. Esquibel. There being no further  comments or input and the purpose of the public hearing 
having been met, Mayor Collins closed the public hearing and referred the application to Finance 
Committee. 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Creating Section 10.24.200, Vehicle Mufflers, Excessive 
Smoke and Unreasonable Noise, and repealing Section 8.56.050, Motor Vehicle Mufflers, of the 
Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to revise and enhance provisions governing 
vehicle mufflers and noise, to establish a graduated penalty structure for recurring offenses, and to 
make conforming amendments as specified . Reporting for Public Services Committee, Mr. 
Segrave moved to approve on third and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Dr. Aldrich moved 
to amend Section 10.24.200 to add a subsection H, which includes a review of data after one year, 
seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion to amend carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body with the exception of Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Segrave voting “no” . Dr. Aldrich moved to  
amend Section 10.24.200 subsection H  to include a review period of not later than  October 31, 
2026, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion to amend carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body. Main motion as twice amended carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body. Public comments were made by: Phillip Boling, Andrew Aragon, Nick Dodson, 
Aaron Sim oni, Chris Shaw, Susann Robins, Cheyenne Crui se Nights, Nancy Sundin, Arianna  Simoni, Lee Filer, Alan Sheldon, Ste phen Jacobson, Jacob Nor dmark, Ashton Doty, Ryan Blue, 
Joseph McCord and Bartimaeus Smith. Comments were made by the following members of the 
governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Dr. Emmons, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, Mr. 
Moody, Dr. Rinne and Mr. Segrave. (#4643) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, various 
tracts of land completely surrounded by current City limits situate in eastern Cheyenne, generally 
located south of Dell Range Boulevard, west of Dry Creek, east of North College Drive, and north 
of Cheyenne Street. Mr. Segrave moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. White . 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body. Comment was made by the 
following member of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich. 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classifications of: AR - Agricultural Residential; MR - Medium-
Density Residential; MUR -  Mixed-Use Residential and, MUB - Mixed-Use Business, for land 
annexed to the City of Cheyenne generally located south of Dell Range Boulevard, west of Dry 
Creek, east of North College Drive, and north of Cheyenne Street. Mr. Segrave moved to approve 
on second reading, seconded by Mr. White . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body. 
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending Section 2.2.8, Assigned Zoning, of the 
Cheyenne Unified Development Code to conform with the comprehensive revision of Laramie 
County Zoning Regulations – referred to Public Services Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending Section 8.60.050, Weeds as a Nuisance, of the 
Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to revise and clarify provisions and specify 
conditions under which vegetation does not constitute a nuisance  – referred to Public Services 
Committee. (Sponsor – Dr. Aldrich) 
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne, changing the zoning classification from P -  Public and MUB Mixed- Use Business 
Emphasis to CBD Central Business District for land located between O’Neil Avenue and Carey 
Avenue, north of West 19th St reet and south of West 22nd Street  – referred to Public Services 
Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Amending Resolution No. 5545, requiring the submission of an updated 
five-year Capital Improvement Plan and establishing a three-year review and update cycle for the 
plan thereafter. Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6486) 
 
 RESOLUTION – Re-appropriating the Fiscal Year 2025 Budget of the City of Cheyenne 
according to the provisions of W.S. §§ 16 -4-112 & 16-4-113. Reporting for Finance Committee,  
Mr. Laybourn moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Esquibel . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all 
members of the governing body with the exception of Mr. Moody voting “no” . Comment was 
made by the following member of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich. (#6487) 
  [CA] RESOLUTION – Certifying compliance with Wyoming Statute § 15 -1-402 for the City-
initiated annexation of various tracts of land completely surrounded by current City limits situate 
in east Cheyenne generally located south of Laramie Street, east of T -Bird Drive, north of East 
Lincolnway and US 30, and west of Parsons Place. Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#6488) 
 
 RESOLUTION – Directing staff to let bids for striping parking spaces and painting curbs 
in the Downtown area. Mr. Laybourn moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion failed due 
to a tie vote. Voting “yes” – Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, Mr. Moody and Mr. White. 
Voting “no” – Mayor Collins, Dr. Emmons, Dr. Rinne, Mr. Roybal and Mr. Segrave . Public 
comments were made by : Rob Dickerson and Corey L oghry. Comments were made by the 
following member s of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. 
Laybourn, Dr. Rinne, Mr. Roybal, Mr. Segrave and Mr. White.  
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Directing the Planning Department to review the Unified Development 
Code and provide a recommendation to the Governing Body regarding the allowance of a greater 
variety of trees and smaller tree sizes in new residential developments – referred to Public Services 
Committee. (Sponsors – Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Moody, Mr. Roybal and Mr. White) 
 
[CA] Lease agreement to allow Union Telephone Company to utilize the Parks Division 
Maintenance Shop to maintain a roof mount communications system to conduct 
telecommunications operations (Revenue to the City) . Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. 
(#8253) 
 
[CA] Contract between the City of Cheyenne, Office of Youth Alternatives, and Laramie County 
to provide services to the Laramie County Juvenile Crisis Shelter (Revenue to the City) . Motion 
(per Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed $91,237.00). (#8254) 
 
[CA] Contract between the City of Cheyenne, Office of Youth Alternatives, and Laramie County 
to provide probation/diversion services to youth appearing in both the Laramie County Circuit 
Court and the Municipal Court for the City of Cheyenne (Revenue to the Cit y). Motion (per 
Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed $82,194.00). (#8255) 
 
[CA] Drainage Easement Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Microsoft Corporation 
for maintenance of a storm water detention pond. Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. (#8256) 
 
[CA]  Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Plan One Architects, 
for the Municipal Building Renovation Design project (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund)  
– referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Contract Modification #1 to Contract #8035 between the City of Cheyenne, Office of 
Youth Alternatives and Cheyenne Regional Medical Center (CRMC) for suicidal/homicidal 
ideation services to youth in Laramie County (Revenue to the City). Motion (per Consent Agenda) 
carried (in an amount not to exceed $98,458.00). (#8257) 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S -1-26 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Construction Specialists, Inc., for the High Plains Arboretum -  Headhouse Roofing Replacement  project (Wyoming State Parks and Cultural Resources – Arboretum Grant). Motion (per Consent 
Agenda) carried (accepted bid in an amount not to exceed $245,700.00). (#8258) 
 
[CA] Consideration of Bid #S-23-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and S&L 
Industrial LLC, for the 2025 Thermoplastic Markings project (2023-2026 Optional 1% Sales Tax 
Fund and 2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund) . Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried 
(accepted bid in an amount not to exceed $438,060.00). (#8259) 
 
[CA]  Consideration to Purchase between the City of Cheyenne, and KONE, Inc., for the George 
Cox Parking Facility Elevator Modernization (2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) – referred 
to Finance Committee. 
  
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S -2-26 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Richardson Construction, Inc., for the Depot Renovation Project (2021 Specific Purpose Option 
Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA] Request to extend the time period in which 1734 Partners, LLC d/b/a 1734 Partners has to 
become operational for an additional year for their retail liquor license, located at 1734 
Meadowland Dr. Motion (per Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
[CA] Application for a bar & grill liquor license filed with the City Clerk's Office for Rich Rich 
Up LLC d/b/a Wasabi Japanese Steakhouse, 4620 Grandview Ave. #205.  Motion (per Consent 
Agenda) carried. 
 
 Reappointment of Jennifer Godonis to the Cheyenne Housing Authority. Dr. Aldrich  
moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Roybal . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body with the exception of Mayor Collins who did not vote (mayoral appointment). 
 
No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
No comments were made on the Revenue Report as presented. 
 
Announcement was made of a Public Hearing to be held on October 13, 2025, at 6:00 p.m. 
in City Council Chambers, 2101 O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, WY, and via electronic conference 
meeting, to receive comments and input for the Bell Building Urban Renewal Plan and Project as 
required by Wyoming Statute §15-9-109.  
 
 Announcement was made that a Calcutta benefitting Special Olympics will be held on 
October 24 -  October 26, 2025 at VFW #1881, 2816 E. 7th Street, Cheyenne, WY  (10% of 
proceeds go to the charity). 
 
Public comment was made by the following under Other Business: Denise Patton. 
 
The following members of the governing body made comments under Other Business: Mr. 
Moody, Mr. Roybal and Mr. Segrave.  
 
  There being no further business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 8:35 p.m. 
 
 
        Submitted by, 
 
              
        Kylie Soden, 
        City Clerk

RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS FOR THE GOVERNING BODY 
OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE 
Office of City Clerk 
 
October 13, 2025  
 
 The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. at the Laramie County School District #1 Board room and via electronic conference 
meeting. Present were: MAYOR – Patrick Collins , COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle  
Aldrich, Dr. Kathy Emmons, Ken Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, Mark Moody, Tom Segrave and Jeff 
White. Absent: Dr. Mark Rinne . Also present: Luisa McGill, Deputy City Clerk. The pledge of 
allegiance was recited. 
 
 A moment of silence was held in honor of Mr. Roybal. Mayor Collins provided a brief 
tribute to his life of service. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda. Upon request by Dr. Aldrich, and pursuant to support received by 
Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Moody, item #13 was removed from the Consent Agenda. Upon request by 
Mr. Laybourn, and pursuant to support received by Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Moody, item #18(b) was 
removed from the Consent Agenda. Mr. Segrave moved to approve the remaining items, seconded 
by Mr. White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
 
[CA] Minutes from Regular Meeting of the Governing Body on September 22, 2025. Motion 
(per Consent Agenda) carried. 
 
 Mayor Collins opened a public hearing to receive comments and input for the Bell Building 
Urban Renewal Plan and Project as required by Wyoming Statute §15-9-109. Comment was made 
by the following member of the governing body: Mr. Laybourn. There being no further comments 
or input and the purpose of the public hearing having been met, Mayor Collins closed the public 
hearing. 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, various 
tracts of land completely surrounded by current City limits situate in eastern Cheyenne, generally 
located south of Dell Range Boulevard, west of Dry Creek, east of North College Drive, and north 
of Cheyenne Street. Reporting for Public Services Committee, Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 
third and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present, with the exception of Mr. Moody voting “no”. Comments were made by 
the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Moody. (#4644) 
 
 ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne establishing the zoning classifications of: AR - Agricultural Residential; MR - Medium-
Density Residential; MUR -  Mixed-Use Residential and, MUB - Mixed-Use Business, for land  annexed to the City of Cheyenne generally located south of Dell Range Boulevard, west of Dry 
Creek, east of North College Drive, and north of Cheyenne Street. Mr. Segrave moved to approve 
on third and final reading, seconded by Dr. Emmons. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members 
of the governing body present. (#4645) 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending Section 2.2.8, Assigned Zoning, of the 
Cheyenne Unified Development Code to conform with the comprehensive revision of Laramie 
County Zoning Regulations. Mr. Segrave moved to approve on second reading, seconded by Mr. 
White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending Section 8.60.050, Weeds as a Nuisance, of 
the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to revise and clarify provisions and 
specify conditions under which vegetation does not constitute a nuisance . Mr. Segrave moved to 
approve on second reading, seconded by Dr. Emmons. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members 
of the governing body present. Comment was made by the following member of the governing 
body: Mr. Moody. 
 
 ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of 
Cheyenne, changing the zoning classification from P -  Public and MUB Mixed- Use Business 
Emphasis to CBD Central Business District for land located between O’Neil Avenue and Carey 
Avenue, north of West 19th Street and south of West 22nd Street. Mr. Segrave moved to approve 
on second reading, seconded by Mr. White . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present. 
 
 ORDINANCE –1st READING – Amending Sections 1.4.3, 1.4.4, 5.1.4, 5.7.10 and 5.8.2 
of the Unified Development Code to define recreational vehicle parks and campgrounds, designate 
zone districts for their operation, create specific use standards for recreatio nal vehicle parks 
campgrounds, and revise manufactured home and parks regulations as necessary – referred to 
Public Services Committee. (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
 RESOLUTION – Directing the Planning Department to review the Unified Development 
Code and provide a recommendation to the Governing Body regarding the allowance of a greater 
variety of trees and smaller tree sizes in new residential developments . Mr. Segrave moved to 
adopt, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried. Voting “yes” - all members of the governing body 
present, with the exception of Mr. Laybourn voting “no”. During discussion, Mr. Segrave raised a 
point of order that comments were not germane to the motion. Public comments were made by: 
Jeremy Hamilton, Phillip Bowling, President for the Cheyenne Board of Realtors, Nancy Loomis, 
Krista (no last name given), Mark Ellison, Manager of Cheyenne Urban Forest ry and Rooted in 
Cheyenne. Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, 
Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Segrave. (#6489) 
 
 RESOLUTION – Declaring a vacancy in the office of a City Council Member for Ward I 
and establishing procedures for filling said vacancy. Mr. Segrave advised  that the item was 
reviewed under other items at the October 6, 2025 Public Services meeting, therefore , provisions 
of Title 2 of the City Code have been met. Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. White . 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. (#6490)   
[CA] RESOLUTION – Approving the Bell Building Urban Renewal Plan and the Bell Building 
Urban Renewal Project pursuant to Wyoming Statute § 15- 9-110 – referred to Public Services 
Committee (Sponsor – Mr. Segrave) 
 
[CA] RESOLUTION – Re-appropriating the Fiscal Year 2026 Budget of the City of Cheyenne 
According to the Provisions of W.S. §§ 16- 4-112 & 16- 4-113 – referred to Finance Committee 
(Sponsor – Mr. Laybourn) 
 
  Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Plan One Architects, 
for the Municipal Building Renovation Design project (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund). 
Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. Laybourn moved to approve in an amount not to exceed 
$1,474,550.00, seconded by Mr. Segrave . Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the 
governing body present, with the exception of Mr. Moody voting “no”. Comments were made by 
the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Dr. Emmons , Mr. 
Laybourn and Mr. Moody. (#8267) 
 
[CA] Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Ulteig, for the Dell 
Range Boulevard Traffic Signal Timing Improvements project (Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund)  – 
referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration to Purchase between the City of Cheyenne, and KONE, Inc., for the George 
Cox Parking Facility Elevator Modernization (2019- 2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund) . Motion 
(per Consent Agenda) carried (in an amount not to exceed $207,420.00). (#8272)  
  
  Consideration of Bid #S -2-26 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Richardson Construction, Inc., for the Depot Renovation Project (2021 Specific Purpose Option 
Tax Fund). Mr. Laybourn moved to accept bid in an amount not to exceed $1,874,421.00, seconded 
by Mr. Moody. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present. 
Comments were made by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich, Mr. 
Laybourn and Mr. Segrave. (#8268) 
 
[CA]  Consideration of B id #S -3-26 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Cheeney Landscaping, for the High Plains Arboretum -  Irrigation project (WY State Parks and 
Cultural Resources – Arboretum Grant) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
[CA]  Consideration of Bid #S -4-26 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and 
Construction Specialists, Inc., for the Dunbar Concessions Restroom project  (2021 Specific 
Purpose Option Tax Fund) – referred to Finance Committee. 
 
 Application filed with the City Clerk's Office for Apple Colorado, LLC, d/b/a Applebee's 
Neighborhood Grill & Bar, 1401 Dell Range Blvd., Cheyenne, WY (license currently held by AB 
Cheyenne, WY, LLC d/b/a Applebee's Neighborhood Grill & Bar).  Mr. Laybourn moved to 
approve, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing 
body present. Public comments were made by: Brian Proffitt and Brian Call. Comments were made 
by the following members of the governing body: Dr. Aldrich and Mr. Esquibel.    
No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
Announcement was made of a Public Hearing to be held October 27, 2025 at 6:00 p.m. at 
the Laramie County School District #1 Boardroom, 2810 House Ave., Cheyenne, WY, and via 
electronic conference meeting, for a bar & grill liquor license application filed with the City Clerk's 
Office for Redbones, LLC d/b/a HamBones Pizza, 415 W. 17th St. Ste. 170 & 180. 
 
Announcement was made that a Calcutta benefitting Make-A-Wish Wyoming will be held 
November 7 -  November 8, 2025 at Red Lion Hotel and Conference Center, 204 W. Fox Farm 
Rd., Cheyenne, WY. (10% of proceeds go to the charity). 
 
The following members of the governing body made comments under Other Business: Dr. 
Aldrich, Mayor Collins, Dr. Emmons, Mr. Laybourn and Mr. White.  
 
There being no further business to come before the governing body, the meeting was 
officially adjourned at 7:17 p.m. 
 
 
        Submitted by, 
 
              
        Luisa McGill, 
        Deputy City Clerk 
 
This notice is available in alternative, accessible formats upon request. 
 
Published: Wyoming Tribune-Eagle 
  October 22, 2025

sites larger than one (1) acre, the required pet areaa may be combined into one (1) or more larger

Laybourn, Mr. Moody, Mr. Segrave and Mr. White. Public comment was made by: Tamara 
Trujillo. 
 
 No comments were made on the Voucher Report as presented. 
 
The following members of the governing body made comments under Other Business: Dr. 
Aldrich, Mr. Moody and Mr. White 
  Dr. Rinne moved to meet in Executive Session pursuant to Wyoming Statute §16- 4-

and stated there would be no action taken by the governing body as a result of the executive

Office of City Clerk 
 
December 22, 2025  
 
The Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne met in regular session on this date beginning 
at 6:00 p.m. in City Council Chambers  and via electronic conference meeting. Present were: 
MAYOR – Patrick Collins, COUNCIL MEMBERS – Dr. Michelle Aldrich (via Zoom), Dr. Kathy 
Emmons, Ken Esquibel, Pete Laybourn, Mark Moody, Tom Segrave , Jeff White and Lawrence 
Wolfe. Absent: Dr. Mark Rinne. Also present: Kylie Soden, City Clerk. The pledge of allegiance 
was recited. 
 
Consent Agenda. (All agenda items listed with the designation of [CA] are considered to be 
routine items by the governing body and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate 
discussion on these items unless a member of the governing body so requests and support by two 
other members is received.  Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered in its 
normal sequence on the agenda . Mayor Collins declared a conflict  of interest related to agenda 
item #11 and abstained from voting on the Consent Agenda. Upon request by Mr. Laybourn, and 
pursuant to support received by Mr. Moody and Mr. Segrave, item #18(b) was removed from the 
Consent Agenda. Mr. Segrave moved to approve  the remaining items , seconded by Mr. White. 
Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body present with the exception of 
Mayor Collins who did not vote.

Consent Agenda) carried.

Development Division’s Community Development Block Grant Program. Public comment was

made by the following members of the governing body: Mayor Collins , Dr. Emmons and Mr. 
Esquibel. There being no further comments or input and the purpose of the public hearing having 
been met, Mayor Collins closed the public hearing.

sworn officers of the Cheyenne Police Department for January 2026 until the end of the Fiscal 
Year 2026. Reporting for Finance Committee, Mr. Laybourn moved to approve on second reading, 
seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion carried. Voting “yes” – all members of the governing body 
present.

Warrants, establishing authority for their issuance, and amending the Municipal Code of the City 
of Cheyenne, Wyoming, to authorize certain city officials, as specified, to apply for administrative
